title: Ambergrove’s new single ‘stills’ is a bittersweet love letter
htmlContent:
Just in time for Valentine's Day, Ambergrove has released a new single called "stills," which serves as the lead track from their upcoming debut album, "I Love You As A Bright Horizon," set to come out on May 2, 2025. This song beautifully captures the bittersweet feelings of love, making you feel both uplifted and heartbroken at the same time. "stills" creates a nostalgic atmosphere, wrapping you in a warm sound that evokes memories of love. While it feels comforting, an underlying sense of sadness lingers, reminding you of moments that can't last forever.

Ambergrove expertly blends joy and longing, emphasizing how special moments become even more meaningful when we know they won't last. The lyrics feel personal yet relatable to anyone who has experienced love. They describe those fleeting moments that seem to stop time, even as we realize they are slipping away. This kind of songwriting invites listeners to reflect on their experiences and memories. The song's production is smooth and natural, allowing its emotional depth to shine without any distractions.

https://open.spotify.com/track/2bJ0T6Y1Erwv21y8sVYt2x

The combination of dreamy sounds and lively beats creates a captivating rhythm that echoes finding happiness in heartbreak and understanding that they can exist together. The chorus strikes a perfect balance, leaving you with a strong emotional impact long after the song has ended. Ambergrove offers more than just a song; they create a mood that resonates deeply. It's a track that feels perfect for driving through the city with the windows down, letting the music take you away. As the first glimpse of "I Love You As A Bright Horizon," "stills" sets a very high standard, hinting at an album that will be equally powerful and immersive.
